posts.trend: 'Rent a garba partner' posts spark cyber safety concerns ahead of Navratri
posts.context: The commercialization of traditional festivals has reached a point where loneliness itself is monetized hourly.
posts.angle: Renting out basic human connection and validation under structural pricing plans.
slides: You can now rent a companion for Navratri.

₹500 per hour for eye contact.
A polite smile for your relatives.
Agreeing that your career is going well.

The rental terminates at midnight.

You are still thirty in the cab home.
posts.caption: For the friend whose relatives ask 'aur shaadi ka kya chal raha hai' every ten minutes. 🪔
